title: Visions dont go
description: Build a custom city based on the modpack!
body:
Visions Don't Go is a cozy and creative modpack designed for long-term worldbuilding, city planning, and immersive construction.

Build the city of your dreams with powerful tools like Create, and shape your world with an elegant blend of automation, architecture, economy, and aesthetic design. Whether you're laying out roads, decorating cozy homes, or automating complex factories, this pack gives you the freedom to bring your vision to life.

✨ Features:
🏙 City Design & Planning – Plan neighborhoods, public spaces, and infrastructure for a living, breathing world.

⚙️ Create Mod Integration – Engineer machines, transport systems, and kinetic structures to support your city.

🪙 Currency & Economy – Trade, own land, and manage money in a player-driven economy.

🌾 Farming & Cooking – Grow a wide variety of crops and cook delicious meals with mods like Farmer’s Delight and Pam’s HarvestCraft.

🪑 Interior & Exterior Decoration – Make your builds shine with hundreds of furniture, lighting, and landscaping options.

🌍 Custom Terrain Generation – Explore stunning landscapes with new biomes and natural formations, perfect for urban planning.

This modpack is ideal for builders, storytellers, and server communities who want to design cities that evolve over time—because in Visions Don't Go, your ideas are meant to last.
